responsibility: This file defines the MIPS operand constraints used by the machine description and register allocator. It declares the target’s register, immediate, address, vector-constant, and microMIPS/MSA/DSP-specific memory constraints, tying constraint letters and named predicates to MIPS register classes, addressing forms, and constant encodings so that instruction patterns in mips.md and its included ASE files can match legal operands and drive reload correctly.
